+---
+assignees:

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Replace the wall-clock waits in the tests with event waits
+---
+The user does not permit time limits or wall-clock waits in tests. Three test helpers still wait on the clock: BoundedWait (a 5 s ceiling), SettledValuePoll (a poll until the value is stable) and GatedWallClock. Change each wait to a wait for an explicit event (a continuation, the output ledger, awaitTerminal, pool footprint events, a gate). Remove the helpers when they have no users. The known issue "a condition that never holds ends the wait…" tests the BoundedWait ceiling, so remove it with the helper. This is its own step, after mail step 2.
+
+Files that use these helpers (55):
+- IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests/: PromptCacheBudgetIntegrationTests, SummarizerPromptCacheIntegrationTests, Support/SettledValuePoll
+- Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTestSupport/: GatedRealModelSuiteTrait, GatedWallClock, TextFileLines
+- Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers/: AnswerDrivenRun, AwaitedCondition, AwaitedEvent, BoundedWait, SessionPlumbingAccess, SessionPumpWaits
+- Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/: AutoCompactionTests, AwaitedConditionTests, BoundedWaitTests, CancelAllSignalTests, ExtrasPoolResolveTests, ForkConcurrencyTests, GenerationQueueSubmissionTests, GenerationQueueTests, HumanWaitGateTests, InlineSettleGraceSessionTests, MailOnlyAnswerLimitTests, MailQueueBatchTests, MailSignalTests, MailSubscriptionTests, MailTranscriptTests, MultiMessageSessionTests, NestedGenerationReentryTests, NestedRunTerminalForwardingTests, NoOpToolCallStopTests, OriginAndTerminalEventTests, PooledResidencyTests, PoolEntryQueueTests, QueuedPassStallWatchTests, ResolutionProgressPhasesTests, ResolveCancellationTests, RespondRunPlaneDrainTests, RoutedSessionPublicSurfaceTests, RouterMetricsTests, RunMessageDeliveryTests, RunProgressDeliveryTests, SessionMailQueueTests, SessionMessagePumpTests, SessionMountCompositionTests, SessionOutboxToolWiringTests, SettledTranscriptTests, SharedGenerationQueueContentionTests, SlotPoolLoaderTests, SubmissionAnswerEventTests, SubmissionBoundaryToolTests, SubmissionQueueSpikeTests, SummarizerSubmissionTests, ToolDisplayDeliveryTests, ToolResultCompactionTests
+
+Rules: no sleeps, no retries, no repeated runs, run the full suite one time. #test
